question: among mass matrices reproducing theta_12, theta_13 and Dm21/Dm31, is theta_23 = 49.1 typical or special?
verdict: theta_23 = 49.1 sits at the 57th percentile of the induced distribution and inside the central 90% band [11.6, 81.8] -- it is TYPICAL, not special. Once theta_12, theta_13 and the mass ratio are imposed, a generic symmetric mass matrix produces an atmospheric angle like the observed one. On this evidence theta_23 may require no mechanism at all, which would explain why Passes 264/268/273/278 kept failing to find one: there may be nothing there to find.
reading: This is the question that should have been asked before Pass 264. A quantity only needs explaining if it is atypical given everything else that is measured. The induced distribution answers that directly.
